'''Noham the Hutt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was on the run from his [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] after bad debts. He held court in [[Squan Station]], backing ventures in exchange for a cut.<ref name="Fly Casual" />

==Behind the scenes==
Noham appears as the Patron template in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
